reviews.text: Bought the City from Rohan. He had every service record ready and let me take it to my mechanic first. Zero pressure, honest about a small scratch. Would buy again.
Smooth handover and he even helped with the RC transfer paperwork. Replied a bit slowly on the weekend.
The iPhone was exactly as described — battery health matched, box and cable included. Priya even waited while I tested Face ID.
Second purchase from Priya. Always well-kept gadgets and fair prices. Highly recommended.
Good condition PS5, came with the games as promised. Meeting point was a bit far for me.
Sofa looked even better in person. Meera arranged delivery the same evening for a small fee. Very professional.
